A summary of staff rotas at the skyport
The desk wrote this for regular visitors
Companion Animal Travel Desk: routine support for traveling pets

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps keep pet travel calm and predictable. We welcome regular visitors, first-time flyers, and anyone who just wants a steady hand with the details. The goal is simple: make each step easier for you and kinder for your animal.

When you come to the desk, the staff will listen closely and guide you through the usual checks. We look over travel papers, carrier needs, and any notes that help the journey go smoothly. Every animal gets patient attention from trained staff, and we keep our tone warm because travel days can feel busy enough already.

If you are traveling with a pet that needs extra care, let the team know early in the visit. Small details can make a big difference, like how your carrier is set up, how your animal settles, and whether the crew needs any special reminders. The department also shares practical instructions with crews so everyone stays on the same page.

Some travelers, like Mariam Bennett and Mateo Hernandez, come back often because they like knowing the desk will handle things in a steady, friendly way. Others arrive with a nervous pet like Cali and leave feeling much more settled. We see that every day, and we are glad to help.

Please bring your documents in a tidy order, keep your pet secure while waiting, and speak up if anything changes before departure. If your plans shift, tell the desk as soon as you can so we can adjust the support we provide.

For more help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
